scope: Website-wide technical and SEO baseline audit

issues.title: HTTP 522 Connection Timed Out on http://www.anyconverter.io/

evidence.dnsConfiguration: CNAME www.anyconverter.io -> anyconverter.io (proxied: true), AAAA anyconverter.io -> 100:: (proxied: true)

issues.impact: Any search crawler or visitor typing www.anyconverter.io or arriving from unencrypted www links encounters a complete Cloudflare 522 server timeout.
issues.remediation: Configure Cloudflare Edge redirect rule or page rule: http://*www.anyconverter.io/* -> https://anyconverter.io/$1 (301 Permanent Redirect) without routing unencrypted traffic to 100::.

issues.title: Missing trailing slash on tool routes returns HTTP 404 instead of HTTP 301
issues.impact: Backlinks or user bookmarks lacking the trailing slash land on a 404 Not Found error page, losing incoming link equity and dropping visitors.
issues.remediation: Add Cloudflare Transform Rule or _redirects rule: /:slug -> /:slug/ 301 to normalize non-slashed requests before 404 fallback.

issues.title: Plain HTTP serves 200 OK without HTTPS redirect (Always Use HTTPS disabled)

evidence.gscEvidence: Google Search Console performance report reveals both http://anyconverter.io/ (10 impressions, 1 click) and http://anyconverter.io/es/morse-code-converter/ being indexed separately.

issues.impact: Splits domain equity between HTTP and HTTPS; insecure connection warnings on user browsers; violates Google HTTPS best practices.
issues.remediation: Enable 'Always Use HTTPS' toggle in Cloudflare SSL/TLS Edge Certificates settings.

issues.title: CTR Collapse on Page 1 Asset (/ip-address-lookup/)

evidence.source: Google Search Console Live Performance Data (last 3 months)

issues.impact: Ranked on Google Page 1 for high-volume US search terms ('ip address lookup') but failing to capture 99.9% of user clicks due to sub-optimal snippet copy and value proposition.
issues.remediation: Rewrite Title tag, Meta Description, Open Graph tags, and add WebPage / FAQ / SoftwareApplication JSON-LD schema emphasizing 'Free Instant IP Lookup - City, ISP, IPv4 & IPv6'.

issues.title: Content Security Policy in _headers blocks GA4 and Clarity telemetry

evidence.clarityStatus: 0 sessions recorded across 30 days despite 45k GSC impressions

issues.impact: All user behavior monitoring (Clarity heatmaps, dead clicks, GA4 traffic) is actively blocked by the browser CSP at runtime.
issues.remediation: Update _headers to permit https://www.googletagmanager.com, https://www.google-analytics.com, and https://www.clarity.ms in script-src and connect-src.

issues.title: 5 Asymmetric Language Clusters Missing ES and DA Counterparts
issues.impact: 140 of 145 clusters have complete reciprocal hreflang, but these 5 hubs/tools lack Spanish and Danish counterparts.
issues.remediation: Generate localized Spanish (/es/...) and Danish (/da/...) pages for these 5 clusters to achieve 100% reciprocal multilingual parity.

issues.title: Duplicate Cache-Control Header on Static Assets

evidence.duplicateRules: /assets/* and /*.css both emit Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable

issues.impact: Redundant HTTP response headers on static CSS/JS assets.

issues.title: Absolute Privacy Claims Flagged on 11 Localized Pages
issues.impact: Potential compliance and advertising policy concerns regarding absolute privacy guarantees.
issues.remediation: Soften phrasing to accurate technical descriptions (e.g., 'Processed locally in your browser without server upload').
